evidence: W deposition was performed using a sequential supply of SiH 4 and WF6 at susceptor temperature of 300°C and chamber pressure of 40 Torr in a 200 mm W reactor. One deposition cycle consists of an exposure to SiH 4 of 100 sccm for 0.75 s, a purge period with an inert gas flow for 2 s, and an exposure to WF 6 of 120 sccm for 0.25 s, followed by another purge period for 2 s.
